title: Executive Order No. 27, s. 2023
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 27

REORGANIZING THE INTER-AGENCY TASK FORCE ON ZERO
HUNGER, AND AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 101 (S. 2020)
FOR THE PURPOSE

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 101 (s. 2020) established the
Inter-Agency Task Force on Zero Hunger (Task Force on Zero Hunger), and mandated
the same to ensure that government policies, initiatives and projects on attaining zero
hunger shall be coordinated, responsive, and effective;

WHEREAS, EO No. 101 provides that the Cabinet Secretary shall be the
Chairperson of the Task Force on Zero Hunger;

WHEREAS, EO No. 1 (s. 2022) abolished the Office of the Cabinet Secretariat
(OCS) and transferred its functions to the Presidential Management Staff pursuant to
EO No. 11 (s. 2022);

WHEREAS, in view of the abolition of the OCS, there is a need to amend EO
No. 101; and

WHEREAS, Section 17, Article VIl of the Constitution provides that the
President shall have control of all executive departments, bureaus and offices;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

Section 1. Amendment. Section 1 of EO No. 101 is hereby amended to read
as follows:

“Section 1. Creation of the Inter-Agency Task Force on Zero Hunger. The
Inter-Agency Task Force on Zero Hunger (Task Force on Zero Hunger) is hereby
created, to be composed of the following:

Chairperson : Secretary, Department of Social Welfare and Development
Co-Chairperson : Executive Director, National Nutrition Council
Vice-Chairperson : Secretary, Department of Agriculture

Members : Secretary, Department of Agrarian Reform

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
Secretary, Department of Budget and Management
Secretary, Department of Education

Secretary, Department of Environment and Natural

Secretary, Department of Labor and Employment
Secretary, Department of Trade and Industry

Secretary, Department of Science and Technology
Secretary, National Economic and Development Authority
Chairperson, Commission on Higher Education
Representative, Office of the President

XXX

Section 2. Unaffected Provisions. Except as expressly modified by this
Order, all other provisions of EO No. 101 shall remain in full force and effect.

Section 3. Repeal. All orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Section 4. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 18th day of May ,in the
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.

 

By the President:
